newsitem.title: USA: Staples, OfficeMax in definitive deal.
newsitem.headline: Staples, OfficeMax in definitive deal.

text.p: Staples Inc and Office Depot Inc said Wednesday they signed a definitive agreement to sell 63 business supply superstores to OfficeMax Inc.

In addition, Staples and Office Depot said they intend to adjourn their special shareholder meetings to be held on March 31 until April 28. Staples signed a deal to buy Office Depot for about $4 billion in stock last September, but the U.S. Federal Trade Commission voted against it earlier this month. Staples and Office Depot have since amended the deal by agreeing to sell 63 stores.
Staples will hold its shareholder meeting in Boston and Office Depot will hold its meeting at its corporate office in Delray Beach, Fla.
